root_cause.text: The error path in ec_bhf_open() incorrectly passed the buffer length (priv->rx_buf.alloc_len) as the DMA handle to dma_free_coherent() instead of the actual DMA address (priv->rx_buf.alloc_phys), causing improper unmapping of the coherent DMA buffer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff changes the fourth argument of dma_free_coherent() from `priv->rx_buf.alloc_len` to `priv->rx_buf.alloc_phys`, and the commit message explicitly states that the wrong variable (alloc_len) was being used as the DMA handle.
